PROPERTY PARTNERS O’BRIEN SWAINE are delighted to offer  16 Finn Street, nestled  in the heart of Dublin 7's vibrant Stoneybatter, No. 16 presents a wonderful opportunity to acquire a charming two-bedroom mid-terrace residence in one of Dublin's most sought-after urban villages. Extending to approximately 60 sq.m. (646 sq.ft.), this attractive home has been thoughtfully enhanced by a kitchen extension to the rear, creating bright and practical living accommodation ideally suited to modern city living.
Behind its traditional red-brick façade lies a welcoming home that combines period character with contemporary comfort. The accommodation is well laid out and offers excellent natural light throughout, while the rear kitchen extension provides valuable additional living space and forms the heart of the home. The property offers two comfortable bedrooms, making it an ideal choice for first-time buyers, , downsizers, or investors seeking a prime city location.
Stoneybatter has evolved into one of Dublin's most desirable neighbourhoods, celebrated for its unique blend of  local village charm set within a wider city landscape.  Its home to many independent cafés, artisan bakeries, traditional pubs, contemporary restaurants and creative local businesses, all contributing to a lively and welcoming atmosphere. Residents enjoy an enviable lifestyle with an abundance of amenities on their doorstep, while still being within walking distance of Dublin City Centre.
The location is exceptionally convenient. The Phoenix Park, one of Europe's largest enclosed city parks, is just a short stroll away and offers endless opportunities for recreation, walking, cycling and sporting activities. The nearby TUD Grangegorman campus has brought further vibrancy to the area, while excellent public transport links, including the LUAS at Smithfield and Grangegorman, provide swift access throughout the city.
Finn Street offers the rare combination of city convenience and village community. Where residents enjoy a strong neighbourhood spirit, while enjoying all the benefits of modern city living. – VIEWING IS A MUST
